business_problem: Meitu needed one cloud platform that could supply advanced image-generation models, developer productivity tooling, performance telemetry, and large-scale analytics so it could improve AI imaging quality for a global audience without scattering workloads across multiple systems.
solution_summary: Meitu consolidated its AI imaging stack on Google Cloud so user-facing content generation, engineering productivity, and product analytics could all run on a common platform. On the creative side, Meitu uses Nano Banana and related Gemini-powered models to interpret user intent, reconstruct images, and generate culturally adaptive visuals for ecommerce sellers in more than 20 languages. Gemini Code Assist helps the development team raise coding and testing productivity, while Firebase gives the company real-time cross-platform performance monitoring. Usage data collected through Firebase is sent into BigQuery for multidimensional analysis, allowing teams to detect issues quickly and understand how product growth, quality, and user behavior evolve. Meitu is also building step-specific AI agents for intent understanding, content creation, detail modification, and multi-channel distribution, making Google Cloud the backbone for human-machine co-creation at very large scale.

data_flow: User requests enter Meitu's imaging apps, are routed to the most suitable Nano Banana model for image generation or editing, monitored through Firebase across device and network conditions, and then aggregated into BigQuery so product teams can analyze usage patterns and improve future AI features.
business_outcome: Meitu improved image-generation quality and cultural adaptability, boosted developer productivity, supported real-time monitoring for global apps, and strengthened retention across a base of 276 million monthly active users.
metrics: As of December 2025, Meitu had 276 million monthly active users around the world.
